thread.title: Beach therapy | Harrison Lifestyles | wvnews.com

author: Toni Ricer West Fairmont Community Correspondent
title: Beach therapy | Harrison Lifestyles | wvnews.com
text:
There is nothing like it beach therapy.
Beach therapy with friends who are forever family is the best. Sun, sand, s’mores, game nights and laughs galore. It is what living a good life is all about. I missed my kids this year, but work life and life in general didn’t work out this year.
Trust me, they are living their best life, and it is all I have ever prayed for them. One good thing about being retired is that when the kids are available, you can be available. The only thing I am worried about now is hearing the words “pumpkin spice” in about every advertisement that is going to be hitting the air waves, social media, etc.
It just means that my favorite season is too close to ending and all these people with an obsession for pumpkin everything and flannel are going to be losing their minds. I am hanging on to my glass of lemonade for as long as possible.
Have a great week!
I leave you with: “I wish that beach therapy was covered by my health insurance.” Unknown

Monday, August 24th, as we kick off the 2026-2027 school year at West Fairmont Middle School! 5th Grade Orientation, 4:30–6:00 p.m. for incoming 5th grade students and their families are invited to learn more about WFMS, meet staff and get ready for a great year. Also, WFMS Polar Bear Back-to-School Bash, 6–7:30 p.m. All WFMS students in grades 5–8 and their families are invited to join us for a fun-filled block party.

Saturday, August 22nd, 10 a.m.-noon. 1st to 5th grades. $30. All campers receive a T-shirt. Attendees will learn the basics of volleyball while having fun with the Fairmont State University volleyball team. Falconvolleyball.totalcamps.com to register!

Back to School Open House, Fairmont Catholic Knights, Monday, August 24th, 2-5 p.m. Pre-K-Grade 8. Meet your teacher. See your classroom.
Golf Outing
Fairmont Catholic’s annual Golf Outing, Friday, September 18th, at Green Hills Country Club. Each player will receive an 18-hole round of golf, a light lunch, beverages, and dinner immediately following. Prizes will be awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd places.
